title: tc-cost-anomaly
description:
Cost anomaly: one spend spike – how far over expected, a chart of daily spend with the expected band, the likely
cause and its share of the extra cost, the evidence, and Set a limit, Investigate and Mark as expected.

description.description: One line under the heading, e.g. the workspace

days.description: Daily spend around the spike, oldest first

spike.description: The spike's day, epoch ms; by default the day furthest above what was expected

causes.description: What drove the extra cost, the likeliest first

evidence.description: The costliest runs or requests during the spike

status.description: "open", or "expected" once marked. Changed by Mark as expected and Undo unless a tc-status-change listener calls preventDefault()

currency.description: The spend's currency, an ISO 4217 code

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

timeZone.description: The time zone the days are counted in

causeLabels.description: The words for each kind of cause, merged over defaultAnomalyCauseLabels

spend.description: What was spent that day, in `currency`

expected.description: What was expected that day; drawn as a dashed line

low.description: The low end of the normal range; with `high`, drawn as a band

high.description: The high end of the normal range

share.description: Its share of the extra cost, 0 to 1

note.description: One line on why, e.g. "Retried every invoice 6 times after a parser change"

label.description: A run or request, e.g. "Run 8f2c · Invoice matcher"

detail.description: One line under it, e.g. "large-1 · 412k tokens · 6 retries"
